verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's first-party docs describe an official Codex CLI that runs in the terminal to inspect code, make changes, run commands and automate repeatable work, with documented flags and commands (`--cd`/`-C`, `--search`, `/fast`, `/memories`). The llms.txt probe confirms the Codex CLI is part of the product's documented surface, and a separate Codex Security CLI (`npx @openai/codex-security`) is also documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, installation and authentication docs in the evidence, and visual file preview or annotation in the CLI.
